description: Create a phased execution playbook for a complex project. The playbook provides per-phase guidance (what to retrieve, what to decide, how to communicate) that is hydrated into the prompt at each plan step. Requires investigation findings and locked constraints from the user.
embedding_description: Create a phased execution playbook for a complex project after investigation clarifies the goal, constraints, and likely direction. Use when work needs per-phase retrieval guidance, decision checkpoints, communication rules, and execution notes that will be hydrated into later plan prompts during multi-step execution.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Playbook written to knowledge base with plan focused in memory
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: A playbook and execution plan have been created. The plan steps reference playbook sections that will be hydrated into prompts during execution. Begin executing the first plan step.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Creating a playbook from investigation context. create_playbook accepts {goal, constraints?, investigation_context?}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. ConnectionError: thinking model not reachable.
